title: Your strength is a threat to their weakness. 🔥
paragraphs: Your strength is a threat to their weakness. 🔥
Don't apologize for the power God has placed inside you. When you stand firm in your faith, it highlights their brokenness. Keep glowing, warrior. The world needs your light. ✨
"If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first."
Follow @TheGospelWarrior for your daily spiritual armor. 🛡️
